customer_question: What documents does the customer need to prepare for the SIG Compliance Folder when registering an End Product?
question_variants: What goes into the Compliance Folder for an End Product registration?
What documents are required for Compliance Folder — End Product using a certified module?
Which customer documents are needed for the SIG qualification package?
actual_issue: The SIG Compliance Folder is mandatory for all new registrations under QPRDv3.0 (post-July 2024). For an End Product built on a certified Bluetooth module, the required documents were not clearly enumerated for the customer.
plain_english_explanation: When registering an End Product, the customer must assemble a Compliance Folder containing specific technical documents about the product itself (not the underlying module). The folder proves the product is implemented correctly and supports the regulatory submission.
consultant_answer: The Compliance Folder for an End Product registration must include: (1) the product operation manual covering the Bluetooth-related sections; (2) a block diagram showing the Bluetooth architecture within the product; (3) an outline drawing (exterior dimensions/shape of the product); and (4) an antenna data sheet that includes radiation gain characteristics.
decision_logic: QPRDv3.0 mandates the Compliance Folder for all new registrations. For End Products that incorporate a pre-certified module, the folder focuses on product-level evidence (not component-level). SIG reviewers use these documents to verify the integration of Bluetooth within the final product.
final_recommendation: Collect operation manual (Bluetooth section), block diagram, outline drawing, and antenna data sheet with radiation gain data before starting the registration process. Missing any of these documents will delay approval.
risk_if_done_wrong: Incomplete Compliance Folder will cause SIG review rejection and require resubmission, adding 1-2 weeks to the qualification timeline.
